title: Launcher run-directory guidance and detached-worker failure diagnostics
outcome: Launcher run-directory guidance and detached-worker failure diagnostics
acceptance: Launching where Git cannot locate the review-runs directory reports safe guidance to run from a repository worktree without copying raw Git stderr into normal completion output.
A public CLI regression verifies the safe guidance for a non-repository launch with no run directory.

Detached _run failures preserve actionable diagnostics for execution.lock refusal and unexpected exceptions in saved artifacts, while ordinary completion output remains metadata-only and a duplicate executor never overwrites the admitted owner's results.
Regression coverage demonstrates both the duplicate-admission failure and an unexpected worker exception without diagnostic prose entering normal stdout or notification bodies.

completion.summary: Delivered fixed safe Git run-directory guidance and exclusive detached-worker stack/cause artifacts with metadata-only completion output, protected duplicate admission, and public CLI/worker regressions. Landed, pushed and installed the exact two-file validated change.
